# awesome-mcp-servers

> A curated catalog of working Model Context Protocol servers for LLM clients, labeling each entry by publisher, execution environment, and mutation capabilities.

The project is a maintained list of verified MCP servers compatible with Claude Desktop and other clients. It categorizes tools by function, such as web search, databases, and operations, while filtering out non-functional or misleading submissions. Entries are labeled with tags indicating if they are official, community-made, read-only, mutating, local, or hosted.

## Docs

- [awesome-mcp-servers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/main/README.md): Catalog of working MCP servers for Claude Desktop and Code, labelled by publisher, location, and mutation capability.
- [Why this list exists](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#why-this-list-exists): Inclusion criteria for real, working, honest MCP servers, plus rejection rules and weekly maintenance verification processes.
- [Legend](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#legend): Definitions for publisher, mutation, location, and cost labels used to categorize every entry in the server catalog.
- [Reference servers (MCP steering group)](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#reference-servers-mcp-steering-group): Official reference implementations from the MCP steering group, including filesystem, git, memory, and sequential thinking servers.
- [Files, Filesystem & Local Data](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#files-filesystem--local-data): Community server for reading, searching, editing, and deleting notes in an Obsidian vault via the Local REST API.
- [Web Search & Browsing](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#web-search--browsing): Official and community servers for web search, browsing, and documentation retrieval, including Brave, Exa, and DuckDuckGo.
- [Browser Automation](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#browser-automation): Browser Use, Chrome DevTools, and Playwright servers for navigation, debugging, and accessibility-tree snapshots.
- [Source Control](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#source-control): Gitea, GitHub, and GitLab servers for repository, issue, pull request, and CI management.
- [Issue Trackers & Project Management](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#issue-trackers--project-management): Asana, Atlassian, Linear, Orbit, and Trello servers for tasks, projects, issues, and boards.
- [Communication](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#communication): Autoposting, BulkPublish, Discord, and Google Workspace servers for social media, messaging, and productivity.
- [Relational Databases](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#relational-databases): ClickHouse, MySQL, Postgres, and Supabase servers for querying, tuning, and managing relational databases.
- [NoSQL & Document Databases](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#nosql--document-databases): MongoDB and Neo4j servers for querying, CRUD operations, and managing document and graph databases.
- [Vector & Memory Stores](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#vector--memory-stores): Persistent memory, ChromaDB collections, and a shared index of software failures for coding agents.
- [Productivity & Notes](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#productivity--notes): Servers for Airtable, Apple Notes, Google Calendar, Notion, and Process Street workflows and tasks.
- [Design & Creative](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#design--creative): Tools for screen recording, Figma design, Blender 3D modeling, and local video composition.
- [Operations & Infrastructure](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#operations--infrastructure): Official MCP servers for AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, and Datadog infrastructure and monitoring.
- [AI & ML Platforms](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#ai--ml-platforms): Gateways and servers for Aident, API.market, Hugging Face, and Runapi AI model generation.
- [Specialised / Vertical](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#specialised--vertical): Servers for CareClinic health records, HubSpot CRM, Invompt invoicing, and Kleap website building.
- [Frameworks & SDKs for Building MCP Servers](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#frameworks--sdks-for-building-mcp-servers): Official and community frameworks and SDKs for building MCP servers in Python, Go, and TypeScript.
- [Discovery hubs](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#discovery-hubs): Reference repositories, community lists, and hosted registries for discovering new MCP servers.
- [Related work](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#related-work): Curated lists of AI coding agents, local AI tools, and privacy-focused AI architectures.
